description:
## Goal

Give the compiler's spreadsheet-style fact engine one generic way to know that a cyclic set of reactive cells is quiescent, and one generic telemetry vocabulary proving that all cell evaluation is change-driven.

This is the only missing infrastructure needed for recursive demand cells to publish monotone current values while downstream artifact cells consume only a coherent settled epoch. The same telemetry is the measurement prerequisite for correcting activation-cell granularity in fz-kdt.13.

## Output contract

- A formula evaluates initially or because at least one recorded dependency revision moved since its previous evaluation.
- A formula whose output is unchanged wakes no readers.
- Cells inside a recursive group may read one another's current monotone values without waiting and deadlocking.
- A downstream settled read is satisfied only when every formula in the exact dynamic dependency group has observed current inputs and no newly discovered edge remains unevaluated.
- A cell or topology change reopens the group epoch without clearing any standing lattice value.
- Dynamic group growth/merge is represented by the same dependency graph; there is no subsystem-owned group inventory.
- Acyclic cells pay no cyclic-group machinery beyond their ordinary fact dependencies.

The epoch is stability state, not a scheduling pass. No root scan, phase order, leaf seeding, cone collection, replay, or bottom reset is permitted.

## Correct altitude

Implement this in the generic fact/scheduler layer. Runtime demand and semantic activation analysis are consumers, not owners and not special cases. The primitive must be expressible and testable with a tiny synthetic lattice independent of compiler semantics.

This collapses two proposed abstractions:

- fz-kdt.42's provisional-publication tier is unnecessary; current monotone values plus quiescent finality are one consistency model.
- fz-kdt.41's activation-specific telemetry ledger is unnecessary; the scheduler already owns formula identities, dependency revisions, output changes, and wakes, so it must expose that authoritative state generically.

Do not create subsystem-specific epoch, revision-causality, or telemetry stores.

## Telemetry proof

Production telemetry must make these invariants decidable:

- stable formula/cell identity without hot-path display formatting;
- evaluations classified as initial or by the exact dependency revisions that moved;
- rebased, blocked, or concluded state;
- output fact changes versus unchanged evaluations;
- downstream wakes caused by each changed output;
- group epoch opened/settled/reopened and membership/edge growth;
- cell resets/replays (required to remain zero);
- whole-fact-table scans (required to remain zero).

Raw authoritative identities should flow through telemetry and be projected by sinks only when enabled. Do not eagerly format types or clone compiler inventories.

A test must assert that every non-initial evaluation has new input evidence, unchanged output causes zero downstream wakes, and adding an edge evaluates only its affected frontier.

## Checks

- Generic acyclic chain: one change walks only its downstream closure.
- Generic cycle: current values ascend to a fixed point without a pass or provisional leakage.
- Dynamic edge added mid-ascent: prior values stand; only the new frontier evaluates; the epoch settles once.
- Removing or replacing upstream ground reopens the epoch and reaches the correct new fixed point.
- Public telemetry alone can group AnalyzeActivation evaluations by stable activation identity and attribute every run to its changed input revisions and changed outputs.
- Telemetry-disabled runs do not materialize display strings or cloned inventories.
- Existing scheduler/fact tests remain green.
- Agent documentation states the cell, causality, and quiescence invariants.

## Removal obligation

This primitive is justified only by the deletions in fz-kdt.4 and fz-kdt.13. Do not add a demand-specific adapter, activation-specific ledger, secondary cache, or permanent scaffold.
title: Fact engine: cyclic reactive cells settle through one quiescent epoch
